title: 错位的时间：为什么我们总是来不及——社会系统的时间错配与可控性边界 / Desynchronized Time: Why We Are Always Too Late — Temporal Mismatch and the Boundary of Controllability in Social Systems
description:
本书放弃“预测崩溃”，转而诊断“系统是否来得及自救”。它在三根不可逆轴（Θ 租佃份额、I 组织复杂度、κ 地缘耦合）之外，提出一个独立的时间来源：时间错配 τ = T_min / T_available 与 可控性 C = T_policy / T_threat = 1/τ。现代社会不是一个钟，而是许多转速不同的钟；错位是结构性的，而非暂时失调。全书五部分、十九章、附录 A—J；不预测崩溃时点，只做受限的局部诊断，并提供可证伪的命题登记簿与开放的数据缺口清单。

源码、数据与构建流程：GitHub。内容许可 CC BY 4.0；代码许可 MIT。

English. Desynchronized Time: Why We Are Always Too Late diagnoses the vulnerability of modern societies through the lens of time. It abandons "predicting collapse" and asks a more actionable question: can a system still save itself in time? Beyond the three irreversible axes Θ (rent/monopoly extraction share), I (coordination time), κ (geopolitical coupling), it introduces an independent temporal source: temporal mismatch τ = T_min / T_available and controllability C = T_policy / T_threat = 1/τ. Modern society is not one clock but many clocks running at different speeds; the mismatch is structural, not temporary. Five parts, nineteen chapters, appendices A–J. It makes no point predictions of collapse, offering only bounded local diagnosis, a falsifiability register, and an open data-gap list.
notes: 科目 / Subjects — 中文：经济学、系统科学、复杂性科学、风险管理、国际政治经济、时间社会学、公共政策、气候与能源治理。English: Economics, Systems Science, Complexity Science, Risk Management, International Political Economy, Sociology of Time, Public Policy, Climate and Energy Governance.
